chart_review_items.title: Generalize metric bars across orientations and series
chart_review_items.current_state: Horizontal chart is count-oriented; bar settings lack first-class grouped/stacked series.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: A category/metric/series configuration can change presentation without losing analysis state.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal and vertical bars accept the same metric.
Grouped and additive stacked modes share categories, colors, and source membership.
Negative and nonadditive metrics are rejected or handled explicitly.
Metric sort and explicit Top N coexist with stable selections.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Distinguish bar glyph inputs from count and measure transforms
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Counts, histograms, grouped count/sum/average measures, grouped series and stacks are delivered.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Arbitrary supplied-measure glyph grammar and repeated raw labels remain broader authoring scope. A new mode is not proof of denominator correctness.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Draw grouped, stacked, normalized bars and areas
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Grouped bars, absolute/percentage stacks, area and stacked area are explicitly delivered chart modes.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Do not list the whole family as missing. Streamgraph and generalized stacking/dodging output reuse remain unestablished, lower-priority architecture extensions.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

current_assessment.statement: RowChartSettings has a category field and row-height settings. RowChart draws member counts. BarChartSettings supports aggregateId and series layouts. Shared named reductions already provide count, sum, and average.
